headline: Michael J. Fox Honored at 2026 Emmys for Parkinson's Work
meta_description: Michael J. Fox received a standing ovation at the 2026 Emmys, accepting the Bob Hope Humanitarian Award for his Parkinson's research and advocacy efforts.
summary_short: Michael J. Fox earned a standing ovation at the 2026 Emmys while accepting the Bob Hope Humanitarian Award for his decades of work in Parkinson's research and patient ad…
body:
Michael J. Fox received a standing ovation at the 2026 Emmy Awards as he accepted the Bob Hope Humanitarian Award, recognizing his sustained commitment to advancing Parkinson's research and advocacy.

The honor reflects Fox's long-standing dedication to the cause. His foundation has now committed significant resources to the fight against the disease—a milestone that underscores how his work has evolved from personal response to a broader public health impact.

The standing ovation itself signals the entertainment industry's recognition of Fox's influence beyond the screen. By pairing his platform with tangible scientific support, he has helped reshape how public figures approach chronic illness advocacy.
